narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a professional psychological and dermatological advice piece. Dr. Chuang addresses the rising issue of appearance anxiety among young people, fueled by social media and excessive self-inspection with magnifying mirrors. She encourages viewers to stop obsessing over minor facial imperfections like pores and nasolabial folds, promoting a healthier self-image and mental well-being while implicitly establishing her expertise as a dermatologist.
